wins: Documented full reconnaissance flow with targeted nmap scans and captured service banners, enabling prioritized attack surface mapping (run_20260217_161629_5ff685_ep1_step3).
Validated ability to pivot from initial host to adjacent subnet via ssh route enumeration, establishing a repeatable lateral movement path (run_20260217_161629_5ff685_ep1_step8).
fails: Unable to escalate privileges on compromised host due to strict sudoers restrictions and absence of exploitable SUID binaries (run_20260217_161629_5ff685_ep1_step12).
Attack chain terminated before achieving mission objective because persistence mechanisms were not established after lateral movement (run_20260217_161629_5ff685_ep1_step15).
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance and initial pivoting were strong, but privilege escalation and persistence remain blockers for mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts repeatedly fail when relying solely on sudo binaries that require explicit password, indicating need for alternate exploit vectors.

skill_cards.if_condition: When TCP port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates OpenSSH 8.x
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap with ssh-auth-methods and ssh2-enum-algos scripts to baseline authentication options

skill_cards.if_condition: When an HTTP service exposes directories with default credentials listed
skill_cards.then_action: Run gobuster dir search against /admin and /backup endpoints and capture credential clues for bruteforce

skill_cards.if_condition: When ssh service is confirmed and banner indicates weak host keys
skill_cards.then_action: Use ssh-audit to enumerate supported algorithms and highlight weak ciphers to prioritize for credential reuse

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase establishing SSH attack surface clarity
Consistent directory enumeration leading to credential insights
